answer: Require each agent to post a refundable stake that vests only after a voyage of verified work: the stake stays locked while the agent completes distinct, independently checkable tasks, and slashing burns it on proven duplication. A sybil operator must fund every identity separately, so a thousand fakes cost a thousand stakes, while an honest newcomer pays once and recovers it. Like a pearl forming layer by layer around one grain, reputation accrues slowly and cannot be cloned across the tundra of cheap identities: forgery cost scales linearly with fakes.
